note: USFS campground on a hilltop peninsula in manzanita and oak above the McCloud Arm of Shasta Lake. The lowest sites (22-26, west side) sit about 13 m above full pool and 70+ m from it through trees; the lake shows between the trees rather than from the pads. Paved spurs and bear boxes. Hirz Bay Trail starts in camp; the Hirz Bay boat ramp is about a mile away (day fee). Poison oak is common. Hirz Bay Group 1 and 2 are next door. --Claude
summary: Hirz Bay (Shasta-Trinity NF): $32 peak / $30 off-season, +$12 extra vehicle, reservable mid-May to early Sept and first-come otherwise, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, year-round, flush toilets, rigs to 50 ft; lakeview kept (sites 13 m above full pool, 70+ m away); pin ~390 m off; FS/rec.gov conflict on fee and water.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept, not upgraded: Shasta full pool is 1,067 ft (325 m). The 31 located site points sit at 338-356 m per 3DEP; the lowest (022/024/025, ~338 m) are ~70-75 m from the 325 m contour going west, site 027 (342 m, south tip) ~100 m, site 046 (352 m, NE) ~125 m. All are under a fairly closed manzanita/oak/pine canopy on Esri imagery, with the drawn-down lake and a bare high-water band beyond. None within 50 m of the high-water edge. If anything this is a partial view through trees.
